cached.title: With memory — keep what we already learned

measurementDisclaimer: This experiment counts redundant K/V row projections, not FLOPs. Naive decoding re-projects Q, K, and V across the whole prefix at every step. Cached decoding, after prefill, projects Q/K/V only for the newest token and reuses stored K/V. logicalKvBytes is tokens × d_model × 2 × 4 (float32 K and V payload), not process peak memory. Repeated torch.cat is intentionally simple and can copy extra buffers; later experiments will motivate better allocation. elapsedMs is an educational laptop timer on a 16-dimensional toy. It does not measure production LLM throughput, GPU memory-bandwidth, or serving latency.
